2607.07401.title: Heterogeneity-Adaptive Diffusion Schrodinger Bridge for PET-Guided Whole-Body MRI Translation
2607.07401.paper_summary: While whole-body multimodal medical imaging scanners have been increasingly recognized for more effective medical applications, the excessive long acquisition time in PET-MR scanning is a major obstacle in more efficient clinical practice. Deep learning-based MRI translation provides a potential solution to reduce scan duration. However, current models often focus on specific anatomical regions and face challenges for whole-body scans that consists of highly heterogeneous feature distributions mainly due to (1) different anatomical regions across whole-body, and (2) lesions or pathological tissues. This paper tackles the challenges through a novel Heterogeneity-Adaptive Diffusion Schrodinger Bridge (HA-DSB) framework. By explicitly modeling translation as stochastic transport between source and target distributions, HA-DSB incorporates region context embeddings derived from a vision-language model (VLM) to enable region-specific modeling. To enhance fidelity of the pathological tissue, lesion-aware metabolic prior from PET is integrated directly into the bridge dynamics through a dual-stage guidance mechanism. Specifically, a PET-guided noise modulation module adaptively scales spatial diffusion perturbations during the forward process, while PET features are leveraged during the reverse process to selectively amplify lesion-relevant structures via an attention mechanism. Experiments demonstrate the superiority of our method across different body regions in whole-body MRI translation and show improved translation quality in lesion areas under PET guidance. Our code is available at Github.
2607.07401.paper_summary_zh: 雖然全身多模態醫學影像掃描儀在更有效的醫療應用中越來越受到重視，但PET-MR掃描中過長的獲取時間仍然是更高效臨床實踐的一大障礙。基於深度學習的MRI轉換提供了一個潛在的解決方案來縮短掃描時間。然而，目前的模型通常專注於特定的解剖區域，並面臨全身掃描中高度異質特徵分佈的挑戰，這主要是由於（1）全身不同的解剖區域，以及（2）病變或病理組織。本文通過一種新穎的異質性自適應擴散薛丁格橋（HA-DSB）框架來解決這些挑戰。通過明確地將轉換建模為源分佈和目標分佈之間的隨機傳輸，HA-DSB結合了來自視覺-語言模型（VLM）的區域上下文嵌入，以實現區域特定的建模。為了增強病理組織的真實性，來自PET的病變感知代謝先驗直接通過雙階段引導機制整合到橋接動力學中。具體而言，PET引導的噪聲調制模塊在前向過程中自適應地縮放空間擴散擾動，而在反向過程中利用PET特徵通過注意機制選擇性地放大與病變相關的結構。實驗證明我們的方法在全身MRI轉換中在不同身體區域的優越性，並在PET引導下顯示出病變區域的轉換質量有所改善。我們的代碼可在Github上獲得。
